mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cplAgencyName, c2.C_Name as cplLiableCompanyName, dp1.D_Name as cplDeclareDepName, dp2.D_Name as cplUseDepName, pcp.Pcp_File_Name as pcpFileName, pcp.Pcp_Year as pcpYear, pcp.Pcp_Create_Uname as pcpCreateUname, pcp.Pcp_State as pcpState, cpl.*, mn.* from Pro_Year_Plan_Select mn left join Pro_Construction_Plan_List cpl on cpl.Cpl_Id=mn.Cpl_Id left join Pro_Construction_Plan pcp on pcp.Pcp_Id=cpl.Pcp_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=cpl.Cpl_Agency left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=cpl.Cpl_Liable_Company left join SYS_Department dp1 on dp1.D_Id=cpl.Cpl_Declare_Dep left join SYS_Department dp2 on dp2.D_Id=cpl.Cpl_Use_Dep where mn.Ycp_Id=#{id} order by cpl.Cpl_Create_Time Desc
select f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Pro_Year_Cons_Plan mn left join SYS_File f on f.fileid = mn.Id where mn.id = #{id}
